$comment: Human-reviewed identity decisions that no published source establishes.
Each alias here is a name campus language uses, approved by a person, and is
recorded as human-reviewed rather than source-derived evidence. Each building
here is a campus map location approved as its own building identity even
though no room prefix places anyone in it. Each location here places an
identity that has no published room in a building: an official page makes
the statement, and a person decided which identity and building it names.
Each room here is an exact published room value that is not a PREFIX-NUMBER
room, read by a person as naming a building. Each Archway group here is a
club-directory page a person approved as an office's own page.
Entries name persistent IDs or Concept3D locations, never names to match.

aliases.note: Approved: campus language uses "Birch" for the Birch Tree Inn dining room. No Ramapo source publishes it. Birch Mansion keeps its own name and identity.

buildings.name: Birch Mansion
buildings.note: Approved as its own building identity, so "Birch Mansion" resolves to it and not to the Birch Tree Inn.

locations.statement: Library in the Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons
locations.note: Approved: the campus-hours page heads the Library's section with this statement and links it to the Library's own hours page. The Library's directory entry publishes no room, so no room prefix places it.

rooms.note: Approved: the published office names the Learning Commons itself; its other rooms are published as LC-.
Approved: Housing & Residence Life publishes its office as "The Lodge", and the campus map's own office list places Residence Life in The Lodge (CPA).

archway_groups.note: Approved: the Archway department page for the Library. Its name, Potter Library, is the department the Library's own directory entry publishes.
Approved: the Archway department page for the Counseling Center. Its name, Counseling Services, is the department the center's own directory entry publishes.
Approved: the Archway department page for the Center for Student Involvement, under the name its own directory entry publishes.
Approved: the Archway page for the Center for Student Success, which links to ramapo.edu/studentsuccess/. Its name is the department this office's own directory entry publishes.

Approved: the Archway department page for Public Safety, which links to ramapo.edu/publicsafety/. It belongs to the non-emergency office, the department's everyday office; the Emergency entry stays the emergency line.
